links.outcome: AI STEMI biomarker vs expert consensus sensitivity and specificity non-inferiority
links.effect: AUC 0.815 vs 0.736 (p=0.081); sensitivity difference 0.042 (-0.099-0.182), specificity difference 0.103 (-0.043-0.250); non-inferiority confirmed with 0.100 margin
links.quote: The 95% confidence interval of sensitivity and specificity differences between qSTEMI and consensus score were 0.042 (-0.099-0.182) and 0.103 (-0.043-0.250), respectively, confirming qSTEMI's non-inferiority.

screen.reason: The study conducts a retrospective reader/comparative study assessing the diagnostic accuracy of a deep-learning ECG analyzer (QCG analyzer) on photographed printed ECGs against expert clinician consensus, but it does not test an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
